title: Canonical Action Controller Identity
changes: Updated knowledge coverage and action semantic contract version 25 to 26.
Updated route/action correlation authority contract version 1 to 2 and explicitly documented identity/source correlation rules.
Route correlation now validates publication controller against both canonical semantic identity and consumer projection identity.
knownRemainingGaps: scanControllerAction and resolveControllerActionContract remain active in the Laravel action derivation path.

Integrated response DTO/class binding and response-contract projection remain owned by the existing LaravelControllerResponseSemanticPipelineInterface and are not fully consumed by the action compatibility projection.
Resource-binding domain publication still traverses the legacy action adapter.
Remaining semantic/relations call sites and scanner subscanner responsibilities have not all been retired.
